scope: Holy Trinity Cathedral in Karachi around 2002, with the crenellated shortened clock tower, barrel-roofed sandstone nave, side arcades and chancel.

originalReview.notes: Calan’s circa-2002 view shows the shortened square tower, its crenellations, triple belfry, dark round clock, pale string courses, barrel roof, arched aisle and high windows.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla file matches Calan’s own public-domain photo in Commons. The listed date represents circa 2002. The older postcard was excluded from the modeled appearance because its tower and nave roof belong to a different configuration.
